question: Cluster ASVs using `vsearch --cluster_fast` at 97% identity to generate centroid sequences and an OTU table. Preserve original sequence IDs as centroid headers (do not relabel).

expected_output.guidelines: Centroid sequences must match the reference as an equivalent set; sequence order, case, and line-wrap may differ. Row labels should be the original ASV sequence IDs (not relabeled OTU_N).

Per-centroid per-ASV read counts must match the reference exactly; row and column order may differ. Row labels are original ASV sequence IDs (centroids), enabling direct comparison without label resolution.
